entities.summary: Francis Ebejer was a Maltese dramatist, novelist and playwright. He is regarded as one of the most influential writers in Maltese history, inspiring generations of writers beyond his death. Some of his most notable works include Il-Vaganzi tas-Sajf (1962), Boulevard (1964), Menz (1967), Requiem For A Malta Fascist (1980), Il-Ħadd fuq il-Bejt (1964).
